Recovered wear bushing with Vetco Gray personnel.

Multiple BOP test attempts with failures: Cup tester installed, multiple unsuccessful attempts to test 13-5/8"-10M BOPs. Changed cups repeatedly without success. Pulled tester, installed Vetco test plug. Successfully tested spherical preventer (300 PSI low, 7000 PSI high for 40 min - OK). Test unit hydraulic hose failure repaired. Waited for Vetco test plug and installed. Current BOP test progress: 25%.

operations.description: MW: Pumping down string and kill line from cement unit WBM 11,2 ppg @ 0,4 bpm/ 80 psi for friction. Close IBOP and fail safe valve at kill line. Perform surface line pressure test with 300/2000 psi for 5/5 min. Perform hang off at UPR with SO 30 klbf.
operations.remarks: Pressure test completed. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Perform FIT @ 0,4 bpm.
operations.remarks: FIT performed. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Stablish ciculation for PWD data recovering.
operations.remarks: Circulation established for data recovery. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Drill new formation 12 1/4" from 3410 to 3418 m with 25 - 30 klbf, 80 rpm / 5 - 20 klbf ft, 850 gpm / 2700 psi, MW 11,2 ppg, ECD 11,43 ppg.
operations.remarks: Drilled 8 meters of new formation. WOB 25-30 klbf, RPM 80, Flow 850 gpm, Pressure 2700 psi, ECD 11.43 ppg. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Perform procedure for underreamer activation. POOH from 3418 m to 3410 m. Stop circulation and drop 2" activation ball. RIH till 3417 m (bit 1m above bottom). Circulate WBM 11,2 ppg @ 150 gpm, 210 psi, 30 rpm, 4 klbft, without pressure spike as expected by Halliburton procedure.
operations.remarks: Underreamer activation procedure completed as per Halliburton specifications. No pressure spike observed. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Increase flow rate from 150 gpm till 750 gpm / 2290 psi at 50 gpm steps, verifying torq spikes from 400 gpm/760 psi on. Stop circulation and POOH drom 3417 to 3412 m. Perform carry out test against rat hole bottom with 750 gpm / 2260 psi @ 3415 m (bit depth) with 25 klbf.
operations.remarks: Flow rate increased incrementally, torque spikes verified. Rat hole test performed. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Perform down link and take SCRs (after reamer activation) with MPs #1 e #2.
operations.remarks: Survey and communication after reamer activation. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Enlarge to 13 1/2" from 3374 até 3377 m with 11 klbf, 45 rpm, 10-35 klb ft, 850 gpm, 2700 psi, MW 11,2 ppg, ECD 11,4 ppg.
operations.remarks: Enlarged hole from 12 1/4" to 13 1/2". WOB 11 klbf, RPM 45, Flow 850 gpm, Pressure 2700 psi, ECD 11.4 ppg. Main wellbore operations.

operations.description: MW: Drill 12 1/4" x 13 1/2" from 3418 to 3711 m, 30-50 klbf, 850 gpm, 2750-2800 psi, 140-170 rpm, 12-32 klb ft, MW: 11,2 - 11,7 ppg, ECD: 11,4 - 12,1 ppg. Set Autodrill, Soft speed and AHC while drilling. Reduced ROP to correct azimuth from 3470 to 3502 m. BOP Stack: 3800 psi. Ditch magnet day/section: 0,75 kg / 3,725 kg.

operations.description: Continued running 9 5/8" casing, 47#, N-80, BC, R3, PSL2 from 5,000 ft to 6,177 ft MD, applying geometric torque on BC connections of 9,000 LBS-FT. Observed increase in string drag from 6,050 ft MD
operations.remarks: Increased drag observed from 6,050 ft MD

operations.description: Circulated hole with 9 5/8" shoe at 6,117 ft MD to clean bottom material until clean returns observed on shakers. Started circulation with 200-400 GPM, 900-800 PSI - finished circulation with 420 GPM, 200 PSI
operations.remarks: Circulated until clean returns

operations.description: Continued running 9 5/8" casing, 47#, N-80, BC, R3, PSL2 from 6,117 ft to bottom at 6,315 ft MD, applying geometric torque on BC connections of 9,000 LBS-FT. Ran in washing with the last 4 joints of 9 5/8" casing with 420 GPM, 320 PSI
operations.remarks: Washed in last 4 joints

operations.description: With 9 5/8" casing at bottom at 6,315 ft MD, circulated conditioning hole with 450 GPM, 400 PSI prior to cementing job
operations.remarks: Pre-cementing circulation

operations.description: Held safety and operational meeting for 9 5/8" casing cementing job while continuing to circulate hole. Finished circulation with 450 GPM, 270 PSI. Verified plug loading in double plug cementing head
operations.remarks: Pre-job safety meeting

operations.description: Halliburton assembled double plug cementing head (6,600 PSI) and connected cementing lines
operations.remarks: Halliburton cementing equipment

operations.description: Pressure tested lines to 4,000 PSI for 5 min, OK. Tested circulation with cementing head installed at 420-500 GPM, 500-600 PSI, OK. Applied 500 PSI backpressure with rig pumps against 2" stand pipe valve
operations.remarks: Line test and circulation test successful

operations.description: Halliburton performed primary cementing of 9 5/8" casing per programmed pumping sequence: Pumped 70 BBL spacer (Tuned Prime) at 12 PPG + released bottom plug + pumped 385 BBL EconoCem 'A' cement + 45 BBL HalCem 'A' cement -- released top plug
operations.remarks: Total 430 BBL cement pumped (385 BBL EconoCem A + 45 BBL HalCem A)

operations.description: Displaced cement by pumping 20 BBL water with cementing unit at 8 BPM + aligned circuit with rig pumps (#2 and #3) + continued cement displacement pumping 459 BBL mud at 10.3 ppg at 12 BPM. Last 22 BBL displaced at 5 BPM, achieving plug landing with 4,050 strokes. Final displacement pressure 1,100 PSI. Tested plug landing with 500 PSI over final displacement pressure (1,600 PSI) for 5 min, OK + released pressure to cementing unit obtaining 3 BBL backflow - flotation equipment OK. Shoe at 6,315 ft MD / Float collar at 6,276 ft MD. Shoe track length = 37.46 ft
operations.remarks: Full returns during cementing. No spacer or cement returns to surface. 176 joints 9 5/8" casing run. 17 semi-rigid Centek centralizers with 34 stop rings on first 17 joints. 176 Mission torque rings used. 1 cold weld and 2 cans casing running grease used

operations.description: WOC - While waiting on cement, dismantled double plug cementing head + disassembled cementing lines + disconnected sliding sleeve from flow line + disconnected and removed 20" conductor nipple + conditioned cellar
operations.remarks: Waiting on cement

operations.description: Released 9 5/8" casing load (from 180 KLBS to 55 KLBS - block weight) + disconnected running tool from 9 5/8" casing + Mission Petroleum dismantled 9 5/8" running equipment and running tool
operations.remarks: Casing landed

operations.description: Made rough cut on 9 5/8" casing + cut and beveled 20" conductor at 38" for slim integral wellhead installation
operations.remarks: Prepared for wellhead installation

operations.description: Halliburton assembled 1 joint macaroni + performed top job on 20" x 9 5/8" annulus pumping 15 BBL cement at 15.6 ppg at 0.8 BPM, 160 PSI. Observed cement returns at 13 BBL pumped. Density recorded in cement returns = 15.8 ppg
operations.remarks: Top job completed

operations.description: Mission Petroleum technician performed cold cut and bevel on 9 5/8" casing
operations.remarks: Cold cut and bevel

operations.description: Mission Petroleum installed slim hole integral wellhead 20" x 9 5/8" x 3 1/2" API 6A, PSL2, slip on sealing 20" x 9 5/8" + tested seal integrity against section 'B' seals with 2,400 PSI for 10 min, OK and against lower wellhead section seals on 20" casing with 400 PSI for 10 min, OK
operations.remarks: Wellhead pressure tests successful

operations.description: Using substructure BOP winches (trolleys), installed BOP stack on wellhead with 11" DSA to 13 5/8" 5M + 13 5/8" drilling spool (3 ft height ext.) + lower ram + drilling spool mud cross + double ram with blind ram and 5 1/2" pipe ram + 13 5/8" x 5M annular preventer + tightened connections with hammer wrenches
operations.remarks: BOP stack installation completed
